implementation.note: implemented_in_code = a dedicated capability handler or tool directory exists; referenced_in_app_code = the entity is used by application source (e.g. repo-pet sprites, CLI) but has no dedicated handler. code_refs are files that reference this entity by name/slug/handler (grep), not a guarantee of a dedicated runtime; registry handler links point at the actual capability function.

lore: Most of the brigade only notices Byte when something is missing, which is exactly the point. Byte keeps the kitchen clean and the waste stream honest: sanitising surfaces, logging waste and closing contamination risks; the image the crew uses for it is a steel counter wiped until it reflects the ceiling lights. The card calls out Algorithm, Accuracy, Data Analysis: the checks Byte runs before calling anything ready.
